title: Deliver a pitch
description: Practise opening, signposting, and closing a professional pitch.

items.targetText: Let me outline the three key points of today's presentation.
Rarely have we seen such a compelling case for strategic change.

items.prompt: Open a 60-second pitch: outline two points and state one key takeaway.
items.promptIt: Apri un pitch di 60 secondi: delinea due punti e indica un takeaway chiave.
items.exampleAnswer: Let me outline two key points. First, our data shows clear growth. Second, the market opportunity is significant. The key takeaway is that we must act now.
items.hint: Use outline, key takeaway, and formal register
